title: Soul Feast #4: Creating Authentic Power – Introduction
excerpt: In today’s Soul Feast, Gary Zukav dives into the transformative power of the New Consciousness and how it shifts our understanding of Authentic Power.
bodyHtml:
In today’s Soul Feast, Gary Zukav dives into the transformative power of the New Consciousness and how it shifts our understanding of Authentic Power. 

He explains how the New Consciousness redefines power, moving away from the old model of manipulation and control (external power) to the alignment of your personality with your soul, which creates Authentic Power. 

This shift, Gary emphasizes, brings with it a deeper focus on the heart and how it becomes the central force in our spiritual evolution.

Gary also highlights the importance of emotional awareness and how recognizing the energy of emotions—whether rooted in love or fear—is essential for creating authentic power. 

He explains that our emotions provide valuable information from our soul, guiding us to make responsible choices that lead to growth, healing, and deeper connection with the universe. 

He shares personal anecdotes and insights into how becoming aware of our internal dynamics, rather than external circumstances, is key to mastering our lives and evolving spiritually.

What Gary Shares in This Episode:

  • (00:56) The shift from external power to authentic power and how the heart plays a central role in this new consciousness
  • (05:06) Love and fear are the two foundational intentions that shape your life’s experiences
  • (10:30) How developing emotional awareness helps you align your personality with your soul, allowing you to create from love
  • (12:30) The concept of responsible choice and how it empowers you to own your emotions and actions
  • (16:05) How the new consciousness is transforming humanity and how it will reshape future generations

Transformational Takeaway:

To truly evolve spiritually, you must learn to shift your focus from external power to authentic power, grounded in love and guided by emotional awareness. By choosing love over fear in your thoughts and actions, you can align with your soul and live a life of fulfillment, connection, and purpose.
